summary.headline: Rishabh Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 8.4% to INR2,128 million; EEI grew 24.9% while aluminium die-casting shrank 36.6%.
summary.overview: Consolidated H1 FY27 revenue grew 6.3% to INR4,111 million, with EEI (electrical and electronic instruments) up 29.3% to INR3,255 million and contributing 79.2% of revenue. Growth was held back by a deliberate 36.6% revenue decline at Lumel Alucast (HPDC aluminium die-casting), which is being restructured for profitability. Margins were pressured by commodity inflation, West Asia-related freight and input costs, and a mix shift toward lower-margin solar inverters and EMS, with EEI adjusted EBITDA margin near 21.1% in Q2. Consolidated PAT for Q2 fell 18% YoY to INR181 million, mainly on higher depreciation and a INR25 million withholding tax provision at Lumel Alucast. The company remains net debt-free with net cash of INR1,698 million.

segments.name: EEI (Electrical & Electronic Instruments)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue INR3,255 million (+29.3%), adjusted EBITDA INR750 million (+29.9%). Q2 revenue +24.9% YoY with adjusted EBITDA margin about 21.1%.

segments.name: Lumel SA (Poland, EEI international)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue INR1,338 million (+24.8%), adjusted EBITDA margin 21.9%, contributing about 39% of EEI adjusted EBITDA. US business revenue doubled in H1; UK +38%, China +25%.

segments.name: Standalone India
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue INR1,656 million (+29.6%) with adjusted EBITDA margin 23.3% and adjusted EBITDA up 16%. Solar inverter and EMS volumes rising at lower margins.

segments.name: Lumel Alucast (HPDC aluminium die-casting)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 revenue INR855 million (-36.6%) by design, with adjusted EBITDA of INR-32 million. Management guides to a PAT loss of INR10-15 crore for FY27, mainly depreciation and withholding tax.

guidance_outlook: EEI segment: maintain FY27 top-line growth guidance of 20-25%; management says the business is running around 30% YTD. FY28 guidance expected to be similar at 20-25%, to be confirmed after Q4.
EEI full-year FY27 adjusted EBITDA guidance of INR140-150 crore and PAT of INR95-100 crore reiterated.
EEI adjusted EBITDA margin expected to close FY27 at about 20-22%.
Lumel Alucast: target breakeven EBITDA (plus/minus 1-2%) for the year; PAT loss of INR10-15 crore expected by year-end, mainly depreciation and withholding tax provisions.

Lumel Alucast: pipeline contracts worth EUR2-3 million annual turnover close to signing, which management expects to secure FY28 volumes. Earlier guidance of 10-15% HPDC top-line growth in FY28 was not reiterated explicitly.
Capex: incremental capital allocation of INR10-20 crore per year for SMT lines and space, after the two building projects are largely complete.
capex_capacity: Nashik: new building capitalised, raising depreciation by INR13 million YoY in Q2; new facilities commissioned in part, with ramp-up, utilisation and throughput the near-term focus.
Solar inverter: new production line commissioned with capacity of 400 units per day (about 12,000 per month); management says a fully automated line has replaced the earlier semi-automated one.
Solar product roadmap: single-phase iUNO 1-5 kW; 3-phase iNEO up to 12 kW; development of up to 50 kW and hybrid inverters underway.
Inorganic opportunities being explored for strategic fit; no deal announced.
Management noted capacity is currently on a single-shift basis for solar, with more shifts possible.
demand_pricing: EEI order book described as healthy across India, Lumel SA, US, UK and China; management sees no demand dip, with seasonal December/January slowdown in Europe and Chinese holiday supply disruption.
Electronic component availability and lead times have worsened due to geopolitics; management says production is not the constraint.

Commodity inflation (copper, polycarbonate, PCB material, silver, CRGO steel, aluminium) is passed through only once or twice a year, so margins absorb the lag; some US business absorbed tariff costs to retain customers.
Solar inverter is a competitive, low-margin market (contribution margin about 10-15% vs 50-60% on traditional products); OEM contracts signed with other brands and EPC channel targeted.
Lumel Alucast: several RFQs at commercial negotiation stage; competition mainly from China, Southeast Asia and India as European die-casters have exited.

qa_highlights.question: Is EEI guidance of 20-25% conservative given ~30% H1 growth, and what is FY28 growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says it is maintaining 20-25% to avoid overpromising given uncertainty; order book is healthy and no specific downturn is seen. FY28 guidance expected to be similar at 20-25%, to be announced after Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Is the drop in EEI margin from about 25% to 21.5% a blip or sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix-driven: rising solar inverter and EMS volumes carry lower margins, offset by higher margins at Lumel SA. Management targets 18-20% long term and 20-22% for FY27 close.

qa_highlights.question: What drives confidence in breakeven HPDC EBITDA and FY28 HPDC top line?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue fell because legacy contracts with price adjustments phased out. New deals adding EUR2-3 million annual turnover are near signing; production ramp takes 3-6 months after signing, so robust position needs another full year.

qa_highlights.question: Why did COGS rise faster than revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Lower-margin solar and EMS mix plus commodity inflation (LME-linked copper, steel, polycarbonate) not passed through immediately; EEI EBITDA still about 22%.

qa_highlights.question: Capital allocation priorities given cash position?
qa_highlights.answer: Building capex largely done; INR10-20 crore per year for SMT lines and space. Inorganic opportunities being evaluated only if strategically meaningful.

qa_highlights.question: Long-term plan for the aluminium die-casting division?
qa_highlights.answer: Focus on returning it to profitability first, targeting double-digit EBITDA; it is about 20% of group revenue versus 40% two years ago. Any disposal decision would come later.

qa_highlights.question: Strategy for the solar business over the next two years?
qa_highlights.answer: Three routes: own brand, OEM supply to other brands, and EPC sales. Management expects 2-3 years to reach profitability near other businesses; the solar business is currently at roughly 0 EBITDA after full costs excluding depreciation.

risks_watch: Lumel Alucast: converting RFQs into production contracts and reaching breakeven; PAT loss of INR10-15 crore guided.
EEI margin trend: solar and EMS mix dilution versus the 20-22% FY27 close target.
Electronic component shortages and longer lead times; commodity volatility and pass-through lag.
US tariffs and duties, which the company is absorbing partly to retain business.
Promoter stake sale press reports. Management declined to comment beyond saying the company would disclose any material development.
summary.management_tone: Confident on EEI and standalone India growth, with cautious language on margins, commodities and component availability. Candid that Lumel Alucast is still a drag, and defensive on press reports about a stake sale.
